answer: New identities join a token-curated registry: each applicant posts a 50 POA deposit and faces a 7-day challenge window, during which any holder may dispute it for a 10 POA bounty, with staked votes deciding admission and the loser's stake slashed. Like umber ink in ocean water, a fake stands out once challenged, and honest voters guard the list as bees guard nectar. Each extra fake pays another 50 POA deposit plus rising bribes as challengers queue up, so 100 fakes cost far more than 100 honest entries. Registry votes, deposits and slashes are on-chain for any verifier to replay.
